AcPfReport.description: The AC power flow verdict from the tellegen engine.

BBox.description: A longitude/latitude box; `east` may exceed 180 for a seam-crossing frame.

circuit_index.description:
1-based position of this branch among its corridor's circuits
(`1..=circuits`); 1 for an HVDC link.

circuits.description:
Parallel circuits in this branch's corridor, this branch included;
every branch of a corridor carries the same count. It is the corridor
plan's count for a synthetic corridor and for the transformers and
connections OpenStreetMap mode adds, and the summed `circuits` tags
(else `cables / 3`) of the joined ways for a mapped OpenStreetMap
corridor. An HVDC link is one row for all of its circuits.

island.description: Index of the electrical island (0 = largest).

BusKind.description: What a bus is for, as the map shows it.

allow_load_scale.description: Allow the loop to scale total load (off: load is data, not a knob).

max_iterations.description: Each iteration is one declared parameter step with an exact DC OPF re-solve.

CalibrationParameters.description: The declared parameter set and its current values.

branch_rating_notches.description: Branches moved up one rating notch, by uid.

rating_scale.description: Rating multiplier per line class (key = class kV), bounds `[0.8, 1.5]`.

oneOf.description: Every objective term is within tolerance.
The objective decreased but a term is still outside tolerance.
No step improved the objective; `final_objective == initial_objective`.
The DC OPF stayed infeasible through every step.
Calibration was disabled or had no DC OPF to work with.

CalibrationTargets.description:
Reference ranges the calibration objective measures against. Each range is
`[low, high]` of the published or measured statistic.

binding_fraction.description: Fraction of branches at or above the loading target in the DC OPF.

hv_share.description: Fraction of buses at the highest voltage level.

loading_target.description: Branch loading the calibration keeps the worst branch under.

set_id.description: Identifier of the reference set (`reference_stats.json` entry).

CountryDemand.description: One country's part of a region's demand under the national basis.

area_share.description:
Share of the country's area the region covers (each part of the region
counted to the country of its nearest place); absent without an area.

code.description: Country code of the places table (Natural Earth `adm0_a3`).

listed_share.description:
Population of the country's listed places over its national
population, at most 1: the share of its peak that follows its places.

peak_mw.description: Peak demand of those places, MW.

unlisted_peak_mw.description:
Of `peak_mw`, the part of the country's unlisted demand the region
takes: in proportion to the area it covers, never beyond its share of
the country's listed population, MW.

year.description:
Year of the national figure; absent when the country has no entry and
its places drew the world average.

DcOpfReport.description: The DC OPF verdict from the tellegen engine.

branch_loading.description: Per branch loading keyed by branch uid (the module's identity).

hvdc_as_fixed_transfer.description: HVDC rows replaced by a fixed transfer on the validation copy.

loading_histogram.description: Ten bins of width 0.1 from 0; the last bin holds loadings ≥ 0.9.

unserved_mw.description: 0 when optimal, absent when infeasible (nothing is invented).

DemandBasis.description: How the demand figure was obtained.

oneOf.description:
Each place draws its country's peak per head of the places table, from
the national demand table (`RegionContext::demand_by_country`,
`Provenance::demand_table`).

Population of the places inside the region × the stated per-capita
draw × peak factor.
The request stated the peak MW.
No place fell inside the region: a per-bus default was used.

Peak MW from the population of the places inside the region. Each place
draws its country's average load per head of the places table (the
national demand table, [`crate::demand::NationalDemand`]) times
`peak_factor`, so a whole country reproduces its national peak; a place
whose country has no entry draws the world average per person. With
`per_capita_kw`, every person of every place draws that average load
instead.
A stated peak demand in MW.

DemandTableProvenance.description: The national demand table behind a national demand basis.

areas_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the bundled country area table the unlisted demand spreads
over.

areas_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the admin-0 file the areas were derived from.

peak_factor.description: Peak demand as a multiple of the annual average load.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the dataset the table was derived from.

Density.description: Bus count per unit area when `target_bus_count` is not given.

ElementAnnotations.description: Per element annotations keyed by the same ids and uids the ingest view uses.

oneOf.description: Generation added so an island or the system meets its reserve margin.
A tie added to join components.

ErrorPayload.description: The error as the wasm edge and the CLI serialize it.

FallbackFrom.description:
Why a caller reran an OSM request as a synthetic one. Written by the
caller, never read by the generator, excluded from the request hash, and
echoed in the report's provenance.

FarIslandPolicy.description: What to do with landmasses that the topology cannot join.

oneOf.description:
Drop the buses of a landmass farther than `max_interconnect_km` from
the connected system (the group of landmasses whose places hold the
most people) and say so in a warning. The default: the result is one
electrical island the engine can solve as a whole.

Keep the landmass as its own electrical island with its own reference
bus and generation. Validation runs per island.

Fidelity.description:
How closely the electrical model follows the region's data: `High` uses
population weighted loads and tight parameter spreads; `Low` spreads load
with a floor plus a random weight and widens the parameter spreads.

Fuel.description: Generator fuel families carried by the report and the fuel mix.

GenerationReport.description:
The full report. Blocks are `None` until their stage has run, so a report
read mid-session is partial but never invented.

condenser.description:
A synchronous condenser the plan placed for voltage support in a
remote pocket: no active power, reactive range only.

max_interconnect_km.description:
Landmasses whose nearest buses are closer than this are joined by an
interconnect corridor (submarine or overhead), like Sicily or the Danish
islands. source: typical AC/HVDC interconnector lengths, ENTSO-E grid map.

Limits.description: Caps that keep a request inside what a browser session can afford.

max_area_km2.description: Spherical area cap of the region, km²; positive and finite.

max_branch_factor.description: Upper bound of `branch_factor`; finite and at least 1.

max_bus_count.description:
Bus cap. A synthetic grid's count is held at it (`bus_count_capped`);
an OpenStreetMap grid drops its lowest voltage levels until it fits
(`osm_bus_count_capped`) and is refused when its highest level alone
exceeds it.

OsmIslands.description:
Island handling for the OSM path, where real data leaves isolated
substations.

oneOf.description:
Join every component with the shortest same-voltage tie lines, tagged
`interconnect`.
Drop islands without generation and report them.
Leave islands alone; validation runs per island.

OsmOptions.description: Thresholds for mapping an Overpass document onto a grid.

clip_buffer_km.description: Infrastructure this far outside the region polygon is still kept.

cluster_radius_m.description: Substation and converter elements within this radius collapse into one site.

hvdc_snap_km.description: A DC line end within this distance of a converter snaps to it.

plant_snap_km.description: A plant within this distance of a site connects there.

snap_km.description: A line end within this distance of a site snaps to it.

voltage_floor_kv.description:
Lines and substations below this nominal voltage are distribution and
are dropped.

copyright.description:
The Overpass answer's `osm3s.copyright` notice: the licence (ODbL) the
data was served under.

license.description: Licence identifier inferred from the Overpass attribution notice (when recognizable).

PlacesProvenance.description: The populated places table behind the run.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the table as loaded.

source.description:
The dataset the table was derived from (the bundled table names
Natural Earth's release); absent for a bare array of rows.

PlanningReport.description:
The corridor and reactive plan the electrify stage made before any
validation ran: what the corridors were sized for and what was installed.

added_level_kv.description:
The highest level the plan added above the modelled ones (one of
`RegionContext::promotion_levels_kv`) because corridors at the highest
modelled level needed more than two circuits; absent when the modelled
levels sufficed or the region has no higher level in service.

angle_spread_deg.description: Widest island angle spread of the planning case (DC), degrees.

branch_target.description: Branches the requested branch factor asks for.

capacitor_mvar.description: Total capacitor rating, MVAr at 1 pu.

capacity_circuits.description:
Circuits added beyond one per corridor because the planning flow
needed them.

capped_corridors.description: Corridors at the cap whose planning flow still needs more circuits.

circuit_cap.description: Parallel circuits one corridor may hold.

converged.description: False when the plan stopped at its round or circuit cap.

dispatch.description:
The planning case: `economic_dispatch_at_peak`, the least-cost
dispatch of the generators serving peak load on a lossless network
with no limits.

filler_circuits.description: Circuits added, heaviest planned loading first, to reach the target.

max_angle_difference_deg.description:
Largest angle difference across one branch in the AC solution of the
planning case at the planned voltage profile, degrees.

max_parallel_circuits.description: Most parallel circuits on one corridor.

max_planning_loading.description: Highest circuit loading in the planning case.

overloaded_corridors.description: Corridors still above their rating in the planning case.

promoted_buses.description:
Buses raised to the next voltage level because an incident corridor
would have needed more than two circuits at the lower one.

reactor_mvar.description: Total shunt reactor rating, MVAr at 1 pu.

rounds.description:
Capacity and stiffening rounds the corridor plan ran (each one DC
power flow).

stiffening_circuits.description:
Circuits added to hold each island's angle spread within the St.
Clair stability margin (44.4°).

upsized_transformers.description:
Transformer corridors whose bank the plan enlarged (up to the rating of
the line it terminates) before adding circuits.

utilisation_target.description: Share of its rating no circuit may exceed in the planning case.

Preview.description: The map preview: valid from `SiteBuses` on, branches from `Topology` on.

Provenance.description: Everything needed to reproduce or audit the run.

spread_sigma.description: Log-normal spread applied to per-branch reactance.

ReferenceComparison.description: One statistic beside its reference range.

Region.description:
A region to generate in: a GeoJSON `Polygon` or `MultiPolygon` geometry
(longitude, latitude pairs; the first ring of each polygon is the outer
ring, later rings are holes) and a label for reports and bus names.

RegionContext.description: The region as the generator resolved it.

area_km2.description: Spherical area of the region polygons, km².

branch_factor.description: Branches per bus the topology aims at.

demand_by_country.description:
The countries behind the demand, largest peak first (national basis
only).

frame.description: Continuous longitude frame of the region.

places_snapped.description:
Places counted in the region although just outside its polygons:
within 15 km of its edge, of a country whose place population it
holds at least half of, and moved onto that edge (harbours and
estuaries the polygons leave out).

population_in_region.description: Sum of `pop_max` over the populated places inside the region.

promotion_levels_kv.description:
Higher AC levels the corridor plan may raise buses to, kV, highest
first: the country's levels in service above its ladder, or 765 kV
above stated levels. Empty when there is none, as in most of Europe.

voltage_classes_kv.description: The line class each level takes its per-km parameters from.

voltage_country.description:
The country whose ladder the levels are (table code), or whose missing
entry the fallback stands in for; absent for stated levels or a region
without places.

voltage_levels_kv.description:
Nominal levels, highest first; a level the corridor plan added above
them (`PlanningReport::added_level_kv`) comes first once it ran.

oneOf.description: Deterministic generation from the region, its population and the seed.

A grid mapped from an Overpass (OpenStreetMap) document passed beside the
request; electrical parameters are modelled, not surveyed.

Stage.description: Generation stages, in order. `Calibrate` repeats once per iteration.

counts.description: Element counts and other integers the stage produced.

elapsed_ms.description: Stage wall time when the host supplied a clock.

next.description: The stage the next `step()` runs; `None` after `Done`.

preview_changed.description: True when `preview()` would return something new.

SynthRequest.description:
The one generation request. Unknown keys are refused here and in every
nested option, so a misspelt option fails instead of taking its default.

branch_factor.description: Branches per bus, `1.0..=limits.max_branch_factor`; otherwise by density.

fuel_mix.description: Capacity shares by fuel; normalised. Empty means the default mix.

generator_count.description: Number of generating units; otherwise 16% of the buses (at least 3).

power_factor.description: Load power factor; `q = p · tan(acos pf)`.

target_bus_count.description: Exact bus count; otherwise `density` × area decides.

voltage_levels_kv.description:
Nominal voltage levels, kV, highest first after resolution. Each level
keeps its own kV for the per-unit base and takes the per-km parameters
of the nearest line class. Empty (the default) takes the national
ladder of the region's dominant country by demand
([`crate::voltage::VoltageLadders`]); a stated list is used as given,
and the corridor plan may then add 765 kV above it.

TopologyStats.description:
Structural statistics of the generated graph (and of a reference case when
measured with the CLI).

algebraic_connectivity.description:
Second smallest Laplacian eigenvalue, by sparse power iteration; `None`
above the size cap or for an empty graph.

delaunay_edge_fraction.description: Fraction of distinct corridors that are Delaunay edges of the bus points.

hv_share.description: Fraction of buses at the highest voltage level.

mst_length_ratio.description: Total corridor length over the Euclidean minimum spanning tree length.

VoltageBasis.description: Where a region's voltage levels came from.

oneOf.description: The request stated the levels.

The national ladder of the region's dominant country
(`RegionContext::voltage_country`, `Provenance::voltage_table`).

The dominant country has no ladder in the table: the ENTSO-E members'
ladder for a member, else IEC 60038's standard levels (warning
`voltage_fallback`).

VoltageTableProvenance.description: The voltage ladder table behind a country or fallback voltage basis.

Warning.description: A non-fatal condition the caller should show.
